rules: Edit ONLY the plain text fields. Keys starting with _ are context and are ignored.
Plain text only: no HTML, no markdown, no ** or [] markup. Highlighting is automatic.
Keep ALL-CAPS keywords, dice notation (D3, D6, 2D6, D6+3) and quotes/inches as written.
armyRules text is a list: one entry per paragraph.
Leave a field unchanged if you have not done it yet. Never delete a key.

text: If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD models from your army, it is Afflicted. CONTAGION RANGE: Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle. Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers. AFFLICTED: During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague. Skullsquirm Blight: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the benefit of cover against that attack. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. Rattlejoint Ague: Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1. Scabrous Soulrot: Worsen the Move, Leadership, and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model’s Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).
PLAGUE LEGIONS units cannot be your Army Faction unless a rule says otherwise.
A Death Guard army can include them with the Tallyband Summoners detachment (up to 500/1000/1500 pts by battle size); none of them can be your WARLORD.

rule.text: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

putrid_detonation.target: One Death Guard Vehicle or Death Guard Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
putrid_detonation.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

disgustingly_resilient.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
disgustingly_resilient.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
disgustingly_resilient.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

plaguesurge.target: Your Death Guard WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
plaguesurge.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

leechspore_eruption.target: One Death Guard model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
leechspore_eruption.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

overwhelming_generosity.target: One Death Guard Character unit from your army.
overwhelming_generosity.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

creeping_blight.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
creeping_blight.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

daemon_weapon_of_nurgle.text: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer's melee attacks score a critical hit on an unmodified hit roll of 5+.

furnace_of_plagues.text: DEATH GUARD model only. +1 S and +1 A for the bearer's melee weapons, which also gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

arch_contaminator.text: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective you control, its models can re-roll wound rolls.

revolting_regeneration.text: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+.

rule.text: At the start of the battle round , select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted .

blighted_land.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
blighted_land.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

relentless_grind.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
relentless_grind.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
relentless_grind.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

drawn_to_despair.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
drawn_to_despair.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

font_of_filth.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
font_of_filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

eyestinger_storm.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
eyestinger_storm.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stinking_mire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stinking_mire.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
stinking_mire.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

eye_of_affliction.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons in the bearer's unit have [IGNORES COVER] against Afflicted units.

bilemaw_blight.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. At the start of your Shooting phase, +12" Range for its Plague Wind until the end of the phase.

shriekworm_familiar.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, Fire Overwatch on the bearer's unit costs 0CP.

tendrilous_emissions.text: LORD OF VIRULENCE only. While within 3" of a friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE it has Lone Operative, and those VEHICLE units re-roll wound rolls of 1 when shooting enemy units the bearer can see.

rule.text: At the start of the battle round , you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift . Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

blessings_of_filth.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
blessings_of_filth.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
blessings_of_filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

malignance_magnified.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
malignance_magnified.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
malignance_magnified.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

grotesque_fortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
grotesque_fortitude.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
grotesque_fortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

rabid_infusion.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that includes two Character models.
rabid_infusion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

mobile_vector.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
mobile_vector.target: One Death Guard Character unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
mobile_vector.effect: Select one other friendly Death Guard unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

deaths_heads.target: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
deaths_heads.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES ) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift ).

final_ingredient.text: BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only. Once per battle, after its unit has fought and destroyed one or more CHARACTER models, pick one Plague: for the rest of the battle Afflicted enemy units also suffer it.

visions_of_virulence.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. An enemy unit enfeebled by its Pestilent Fallout is also Afflicted.

needle_of_nurgle.text: PLAGUE SURGEON only. Tainted Narthecium returns up to D3 destroyed models instead of 1.

cornucophagus.text: Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

rule.text: A PLAGUE LEGIONS unit within 7" of one of your DEATH GUARD units has Nurgle's Gift. A DEATH GUARD unit within 7" of one of your PLAGUE LEGIONS units gets +3" Contagion Range. You can include PLAGUE LEGIONS units up to 500 pts (Incursion), 1000 pts (Strike Force) or 1500 pts (Onslaught); none of them can be your WARLORD.

persistent_pests.target: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
persistent_pests.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
persistent_pests.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

clutching_corruption.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
clutching_corruption.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more Plague Legions units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

all_is_rot.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
all_is_rot.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

fleshy_avalanche.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
fleshy_avalanche.target: One Plague Legions Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
fleshy_avalanche.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

avatars_of_decay.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army.
avatars_of_decay.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

mireslick.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
mireslick.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
mireslick.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

beckoning_blight.text: DEATH GUARD model only. A PLAGUE LEGIONS unit arriving by Deep Strike wholly within 12" of the bearer can be set up more than 6" (instead of 8") horizontally from enemy models.

fell_harvester.text: DEATH GUARD model only. +2 A for the bearer's melee weapons.

entropic_knell.text: GREAT UNCLEAN ONE only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" that is below Starting Strength takes a battle-shock test at -1.

tome_of_bounteous_blessings.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. PLAGUE LEGIONS units within 12" get +1 to battle-shock tests; when one passes, a model regains up to D3 wounds (a BATTLELINE unit gets up to D3 destroyed models back instead).

rule.text: In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds , depending on your chosen battle size, add a new POXWALKERS unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves .

grip_of_the_walking_pox.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
grip_of_the_walking_pox.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
grip_of_the_walking_pox.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

smeared_with_filth.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
smeared_with_filth.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

gnawing_hunger.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.
gnawing_hunger.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

hidden_amongst_the_dead.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
hidden_amongst_the_dead.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
hidden_amongst_the_dead.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

shock_and_horror.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Death Guard unit from your army ends a Charge move.
shock_and_horror.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

shambling_wall.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
shambling_wall.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
shambling_wall.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.

witherbone_pipes.text: NOXIOUS BLIGHTBRINGER only. While it leads POXWALKERS, they get +1 OC and +1 to battle-shock and Leadership tests.

lord_of_the_walking_pox.text: DEATH GUARD model only. If the bearer leads POXWALKERS in Strategic Reserves, treat the battle round as the third when setting that unit up.

sorrowsyphon.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, after the bearer's unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer's unit are destroyed. (Also grants Plague Wind +1 Damage while leading Poxwalkers if that clause exists.)

talisman_of_burgeoning.text: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer leads a unit, POXWALKERS models in it get +1 Toughness.

rule.text: In your opponent’s Command phase , roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength . If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds .

blooming_pestilence.target: One Terminator unit from your army.
blooming_pestilence.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.

grim_reapers.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
grim_reapers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.

undying_spite.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
undying_spite.target: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
undying_spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

signal_pox.target: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.
signal_pox.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.

mortarions_teachings.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
mortarions_teachings.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.

sickening_impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
sickening_impact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

face_of_death.text: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of the Fight phase every enemy unit engaged with the bearer's unit takes a battle-shock test.

vile_vigour.text: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer leads a unit, its models get +1" Move and can re-roll Advance rolls.

warprot_talisman.text: TERMINATOR model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not engaged it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

helm_of_the_fly_king.text: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer leads a unit, it can only be shot by models within 18".

rule.text: For all their slow degeneration, many of the Death Guard’s war machines are augmented with a fevered and inexorable urgency that brings their corrupted weapons to bear upon the foe all too quickly Friendly FOETID BLOAT-DRONE / FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER / HELBRUTE / MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE .

fresh_vectors.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase , when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack .
fresh_vectors.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

bloodrust_deluge.when: Your Shooting phase , when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot .
bloodrust_deluge.effect: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked .

soulrot_flux.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase , when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move , if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
soulrot_flux.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , roll one D6: On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound . On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds . On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds .

parasitic_woe_reaper.text: CONTAGION ENGINE unit only. After this unit has fought, one of its models heals D3 wounds.

lancet_of_the_worldsore.text: HELBRUTE or MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER only. This unit has MOBILE.

rule.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to two friendly PLAGUE MARINES units. This detachment has the FLYBLOWN tag and cannot be taken with another FLYBLOWN detachment .

nauseating_paroxysms.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
nauseating_paroxysms.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

droning_horror.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
droning_horror.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that attack targets a unit within half range, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

eye_of_the_swarm.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
eye_of_the_swarm.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.

insectile_murmuration.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. Its attacks against a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

plagueveil.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

rule.text: The rancid champions of the Death Guard are blessed with the most virulent contagions of Nurgle, supernatural strains that radiate towards unwilling hosts in floods of foulness Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" to their Contagion Range (to a maximum of 12").

territorial_infection.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
territorial_infection.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

aggravus_spasms.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
aggravus_spasms.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range .

simultaneous_contamination.when: Your Shooting phase , when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action .
simultaneous_contamination.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot .

rejuvenating_swarm.text: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only (not TERMINATOR). Attacks against the bearer's unit with S greater than its T get -1 to wound.

host_of_the_hybridised_pox.text: Enemy units within Contagion Range of this unit also have the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

Supreme Commander.text: If this model is in your army, it must be your WARLORD.

Host of Plagues.text: End of your Movement phase: roll D6 for each enemy unit within 6" (+1 if it is Afflicted). On a 3+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Lord of the Death Guard.text: Once per turn Mortarion can use one of these: Diseased Influence - after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of a friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD unit within 6" of him, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 5". Boon of Death - in the Fight phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 6" is targeted, until the end of the phase its models destroyed by melee attacks before fighting roll D6: on a 2+ they fight after the attacker, then are removed. Inflamed Reprisal - in your opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 6" is targeted, after the attacker finishes, that unit can shoot back at it as if it were your Shooting phase, with -1 BS.

The Destroyer Hive.text: While this model leads a unit, melee attacks against that unit get -1 to hit.

Eater Plague (Psychic).text: In your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model and roll one D6: on a 1, this model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Death Guard Defenders.text: While within 3" of a friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit, this model has Lone Operative.

Fevered Strategist.text: Once per battle round (one model with this ability per army): when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 12" is targeted with a Stratagem, that use costs 1CP less.

Miasma of Pestilence (Aura).text: Friendly DEATH GUARD units within 6" have the benefit of cover against ranged attacks.

daemon_prince_of_nurgle_with_wings._name: Daemon Prince of Nurgle with Wings

Horrifying Visage.text: Each time this model ends a Charge move, pick one enemy unit engaged with it: that unit takes a battle-shock test at -1.

Enfeebling Miasma (Aura).text: Enemy units (not MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 6" must take Desperate Escape tests whenever they fall back, at -1 if they are battle-shocked.

Vector of Disease.text: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons in that unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LANCE].

Unholy Resilience.text: The first time this model is destroyed in a battle round, roll D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+ set it back up as close as possible to where it died (not in Engagement Range) with 3 wounds. Once per battle.

Virulent Aura.text: While this model leads a unit, ranged attacks by that unit can re-roll the wound roll.

Blight Bombardment.text: Start of your Shooting phase: pick one visible enemy unit within 30". Until the end of the phase, friendly DEATH GUARD ranged attacks against it re-roll hit rolls of 1 (Blast weapons can re-roll the hit roll).

Gift of Poxes.text: This model's Contagion Range is 3" larger.

Shroud of Disease.text: While this model leads a unit, that unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18".

Gift of Contagion (Psychic).text: While this model leads a unit, that unit's attacks against Afflicted units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Pestilent Fallout (Psychic).text: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: pick one enemy INFANTRY unit hit by its Plague Wind. Until the end of your opponent's next turn it is enfeebled: -2" Move.

Sickening Vitality.text: While this model leads a unit, that unit gets +1" Move and can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Tocsin of Misery (Aura).text: Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase: each enemy unit below Starting Strength within 9" takes a battle-shock test (-1 if it is a PSYKER unit).

Putrefying Stink.text: Enemy models cannot start or end an Advance move within 9" of this model.

Blinding Spray.text: Fight phase: one model with this ability per army can give its unit Fights First until the end of the phase. Each model once per battle.

Extraction of Fresh Disease.text: The first time this model's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, this model gets +6 OC for the rest of the battle.

Foul Infusion.text: While this model leads a unit, that unit's weapons have [LETHAL HITS] and score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

Malicious Calculations.text: While this model leads a unit, that unit's attacks can ignore any or all modifiers to BS/WS and to the hit roll.

Sevenfold Chant.text: Your Command phase: if this model is on the battlefield, roll 2D6. On 7+ you gain 1CP.

Tainted Narthecium.text: While this model leads a unit, in your Command phase you can return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit.

Inflamed Infections.text: Until the end of the phase, each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Unclean Icon.text: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit get +1 OC.

Blessed Icon of Disease.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase: one friendly battle-shocked DEATH GUARD unit within 12" stops being battle-shocked.

Infused with the Blessings of Nurgle.text: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots: pick one enemy unit it hit. It is Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

Icon of Despair (Aura).text: Enemy units within 6" of the bearer get -1 Leadership.

Curse of the Walking Pox.text: Each time a Poxwalker destroys an enemy model (not MONSTER or VEHICLE), after the unit's attacks you can return one destroyed Poxwalker to the unit. While TYPHUS leads the unit, models killed by his Eater Plague count too.

Blistering Fusillade.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

Silent Bodyguard.text: While a CHARACTER leads this unit, that CHARACTER has Feel No Pain 4+.

Death Approaches.text: In your Movement phase, when this unit arrives by Deep Strike it can be set up more than 6" horizontally from Afflicted enemy units (and more than 8" from other enemy units).

Icon of Despair (Aura).text: Enemy units within 6" of the bearer get -1 Leadership.

Lethal Ichor.text: Each time a melee attack is allocated to a model in this unit, after the attacking unit finishes, roll D6 (max six per attacking unit): each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the attacking unit.

Diseased Malice.text: Attacks by this model against Afflicted units get +1 to wound.

Froth-spattered Frenzy.text: If equipped with 2 melee weapons besides its close combat weapon, those two weapons get +2 A.

Tank Hunters.text: Your Shooting phase: attacks against MONSTER or VEHICLE units get +1 to hit and +1 to wound.

Hovering Death.text: This model can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it fell back.

foetid_bloat_drone_hbl._name: Foetid Bloat-drone with Heavy Blight Launcher

Explosive Blight.text: Your Shooting phase: when this model's attack destroys an enemy unit, roll D6 before removing its last model (+1 if it was Afflicted). On a 5+ every enemy unit within 6" of that model is Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

Spore-laced Shock Waves.text: After resolving all of this model's attacks against the target unit, each unit struck by spores suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Assault Ramp.text: A unit that disembarks after this model made a Normal move makes an assault disembark move.

Metalophagic Infection.text: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: pick one MONSTER or VEHICLE unit it hit and roll D6 (+1 if Afflicted). On a 5+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Hail of Corrosive Disease.text: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: pick one enemy unit (not MONSTER or VEHICLE) it hit. Until the end of the phase, friendly DEATH GUARD ranged attacks against it get +1 AP (once per phase per enemy unit).

Scuttling Walker.text: On Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves it can move through models (not TITANIC) and terrain, crossing Engagement Range without ending there; it automatically passes Desperate Escape tests.

Barrage of Filth.text: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: one enemy unit it hit cannot have the benefit of cover until the end of the phase.

Fire Support.text: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: pick one enemy unit it hit. Until the end of the phase, models that disembarked from it this turn can re-roll wound rolls against that unit.

Putrescent Fog (Aura).text: Enemy units arriving as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

Diseased Cover.text: A model that is not fully visible to the attacking unit because of this Fortification has the benefit of cover against that ranged attack.

Deployment.text: Deploy both parts within 1" of each other; together they count as a single model.

Fortification.text: While an enemy unit is only within Engagement Range of your FORTIFICATIONS, it can still be shot (non-Pistol attacks get -1 to hit), and its models do not take Desperate Escape tests for falling back while battle-shocked (unless moving over enemy models).

Daemon Lord of Nurgle (Aura).text: Friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS units within 6" get +1 Toughness.

Nurgle’s Rot (Psychic).text: End of your Movement phase: pick one enemy unit within 12". Until the start of your next Movement phase it is rotted: -1 Toughness.

Virulent Blessing (Psychic).text: Start of the Fight phase: pick one visible enemy unit within 24". Until the end of the phase, attacks by PLAGUE LEGIONS models allocated to it get +1 Damage.

Deluge of Nurgle (Aura).text: Enemy units within 6" get -2" Move and -1 OC.

Infected Outbreak.text: End of your Command phase: if this unit is within range of an objective you control, it stays yours until your opponent's Level of Control over it is higher at the end of a phase.

Daemonic Icon.text: Models in the bearer's unit have Leadership 6+.

Instrument of Chaos.text: +1 to charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

Death’s Heads.text: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots: pick one enemy unit it hit. Until the end of the turn, friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS attacks against it can re-roll the wound roll.

Daemonic Icon.text: Models in the bearer's unit have Leadership 6+.

Instrument of Chaos.text: +1 to charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

Grotesque Regeneration.text: At the end of each phase, each Beast of Nurgle that lost wounds but was not destroyed regains all of them.

Mischief Makers.text: Each time an enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) within Engagement Range of one or more units with this ability is selected to fight, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
